- Confirm which team at Redwood will own evidence for items like network diagrams, retention policies, and access reviews
- Understand the cadence for evidence delivery (one-off vs. ongoing)
- Walk through any compensating controls for data residency and KMS usage

Attached is our initial SIG spreadsheet (lightly populated) and a vendor Q document with some targeted questions.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Thu 9/30, 10:00–10:30 or 15:30–16:00
- Fri 10/1, 09:00–09:30 or 11:00–11:30

If you prefer, send over the best time and we’ll adapt. Also: who should be our primary evidence contact at Redwood?

Thanks,
Alex Turner

Alex / team — quick technical clarifications ahead of the call: 

- For the network diagram ask: we maintain a redacted infra diagram that shows cluster boundaries, VPC/subnet layout, and ingress/egress controls. We can provide a version that omits customer tenant identifiers.
- Logging: we retain control-plane and inference logs for 90 days by default. For customers requiring longer retention we support configurable retention and can discuss an export cadence.
- KMS: customer-managed keys (BYOK) are supported for Private deployments; hosted customers use Redwood-managed KMS with envelope encryption.

Suggested evidence split (so we can pre-stage docs):
- Hannah: SOC2 report, policy docs (retention, incident response, change mgmt)
- Marcus: infra diagram, logging architecture, network ACLs
- Laura: any contract-specific language or terms to review

I'll prep the redacted infra diagram and a short evidence index for the call and upload to the shared drive after the meeting.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
